name: Helpview
tagline: Helpview turns Notion into a polished help center for customers and a shared knowledge base for internal teams
description: Helpview turns Notion into a polished help center for customers and a shared knowledge base for internal teams. Instead of moving content into a separate system, teams can keep writing and organizing everything in Notion, then publish it through Helpview as a structured, branded help center. Helpview is built for startups, SaaS companies, agencies, and small teams that want a faster way to launch documentation without sacrificing presentation.
